title: Residual reasons: the closed keys a residual row names when it gives no residual, with one sentence each (E119b)

sections.description: Why a row of a residual result has no residual. The first seven are E119a's crossing reasons, copied as literals (the parity test with E119a's REASONS is E119b slice 2's); no-top and many-crossings are E119b's. A sentence names no wellbore and no formation (those stay under Technical details); <a> and <b> are the measured depths of the row's between, in metres, and appear only in the four keys that carry one.

keys.sentence: Not computed: the path comes within 0.01 m of the surface from <a> m to <b> m, and no crossing is proven.
Not computed: the path runs within 0.01 m of the surface from <a> m to <b> m, and no crossing is proven.
Not computed: a crossing is possible between <a> m and <b> m but could not be proven.
Not computed: the surface has no data where the path would cross it.
Not computed: the path ends above the surface.
Not computed: the path starts below the surface.
Not computed: this wellbore has no trajectory in the selection.
Not computed: this wellbore has no top of the chosen formation.
Not computed: the path crosses the surface more than 64 times between <a> m and <b> m.
